verification\n445\t\n446\t---\n447\t\n448\t## URL Pattern Reference\n449\t\n450\t### GFS Archive URL Pattern\n451\t```\n452\thttps://nomads.ncep.noaa.gov/pub/data/nccf/com/gfs/prod/gfs.YYYYMMDD/CC/atmos/gfs.tCCz.pgrb2.RRRR.fFFF\n453\t```\n454\t\n455\tWhere:\n456\t- `YYYYMMDD` = Model run date (e.g., 20260724)\n457\t- `CC` = Cycle time (00, 06, 12, 18)\n458\t- `RRRR` = Resolution code (0p25, 0p50, 1p00)\n459\t- `FFF` = Forecast hour (000-384)\n460\t\n461\t### Example URL
